items.author: thetruewisegamer.bsky.social
items.context: maybe someone smarter than me can explain why deadlock is like still not freely available? like i know a lot about the game and i feel like doing a whole song and dance to just play it is not worth that and kinda insulting.
items.text: From what I know, Deadlock is still an invite-only playtest, so access goes through invites from friends who already play. Worth checking its Steam page for the latest, in case that has changed.
items.verify: Проверить на странице Deadlock в Steam, что игра всё ещё только по приглашениям (Википедия на май 2026 так пишет, свежее не нашёл).
